text.ro: Exista o politica de securitate a informatiei aprobata de management?
text.en: Is there an information security policy approved by management?

recommendation.ro: Definiti si aprobati o politica de securitate a informatiei la nivel de management.
recommendation.en: Define and approve an information security policy at management level.

nis2: Policies on risk analysis and information system security

text.ro: Exista obiective ISMS documentate si monitorizate?
text.en: Are ISMS objectives documented and monitored?

recommendation.ro: Definiti obiective ISMS masurabile si revizuiti progresul periodic.
recommendation.en: Define measurable ISMS objectives and review progress periodically.

text.ro: Exista evaluari periodice de risc pentru securitatea informatiei?
text.en: Are periodic information security risk assessments performed?

recommendation.ro: Implementati un proces formal de evaluare periodica a riscurilor de securitate.
recommendation.en: Implement a formal process for periodic information security risk assessments.

text.ro: Conducerea revizuieste periodic performanta programului de securitate?
text.en: Does management periodically review the security program performance?

recommendation.ro: Introduceti management review periodic cu KPI, riscuri si planuri de actiune.
recommendation.en: Introduce periodic management review with KPIs, risks and action plans.

text.ro: Exista un registru al exceptiilor / riscurilor acceptate?
text.en: Is there a register of exceptions / accepted risks?

recommendation.ro: Creati un registru pentru exceptii, riscuri acceptate, owner si termen de revizuire.
recommendation.en: Create a register for exceptions, accepted risks, owner and review date.

text.ro: Sunt rolurile si responsabilitatile de securitate definite clar?
text.en: Are security roles and responsibilities clearly defined?

recommendation.ro: Formalizati rolurile si responsabilitatile de securitate in organigrama si politici.
recommendation.en: Formalize security roles and responsibilities in the organization chart and policies.

text.ro: Exista audit intern pentru ISMS?
text.en: Is there an internal audit process for the ISMS?

recommendation.ro: Planificati audituri interne ISMS cu criterii, scope si remediere urmarita.
recommendation.en: Plan ISMS internal audits with criteria, scope and tracked remediation.

text.ro: Exista un proces de imbunatatire continua pentru controalele de securitate?
text.en: Is there a continual improvement process for security controls?

recommendation.ro: Implementati un proces de imbunatatire continua bazat pe audituri, incidente si metrici.
recommendation.en: Implement a continual improvement process based on audits, incidents and metrics.

text.ro: Exista un inventar complet al activelor informationale si tehnologice?
text.en: Is there a complete inventory of information and technology assets?

recommendation.ro: Implementati un inventar complet al activelor si reconciliere periodica.
recommendation.en: Implement a complete asset inventory and periodic reconciliation.

text.ro: Activele sunt clasificate dupa criticitate si sensibilitate?
text.en: Are assets classified by criticality and sensitivity?

recommendation.ro: Definiti clasificarea activelor si etichetati activele critice si sensibile.
recommendation.en: Define asset classification and label critical and sensitive assets.

text.ro: Exista proprietari desemnati pentru activele critice?
text.en: Are owners assigned to critical assets?

recommendation.ro: Atribuiti owner pentru toate activele critice si responsabilitati de control.
recommendation.en: Assign owners for all critical assets and define control responsibilities.

text.ro: Exista reguli pentru utilizarea acceptabila a activelor?
text.en: Are acceptable use rules defined for assets?

recommendation.ro: Publicati si comunicati reguli de utilizare acceptabila pentru active si date.
recommendation.en: Publish and communicate acceptable use rules for assets and data.

text.ro: Exista evidenta mediilor de stocare si a eliminarii lor sigure?
text.en: Is there an inventory of storage media and secure disposal process?

recommendation.ro: Implementati controlul mediilor de stocare si eliminare sigura certificata.
recommendation.en: Implement storage media control and certified secure disposal.

text.ro: Exista proces formal de onboarding / offboarding al activelor?
text.en: Is there a formal process for asset onboarding / offboarding?

recommendation.ro: Definiti procese pentru introducerea si scoaterea din uz a activelor.
recommendation.en: Define processes for asset onboarding and decommissioning.

text.ro: Sunt activele shadow IT identificate si tratate?
text.en: Are shadow IT assets identified and treated?

recommendation.ro: Folositi discovery si controale CASB / MDM pentru identificarea shadow IT.
recommendation.en: Use discovery and CASB / MDM controls to identify shadow IT.

text.ro: Exista protectii pentru active mobile si BYOD?
text.en: Are protections in place for mobile assets and BYOD?

recommendation.ro: Implementati politici BYOD si controale MDM/MAM pentru dispozitive mobile.
recommendation.en: Implement BYOD policies and MDM/MAM controls for mobile devices.

text.ro: Exista o politica de control al accesului?
text.en: Is there an access control policy?

recommendation.ro: Definiti si aprobati o politica de control al accesului bazata pe least privilege.
recommendation.en: Define and approve an access control policy based on least privilege.

text.ro: Accesul utilizatorilor este aprobat formal?
text.en: Is user access formally approved?

recommendation.ro: Introduceti aprobare formala pentru acces nou, modificat si revocat.
recommendation.en: Introduce formal approval for new, changed and revoked access.

text.ro: Accesul privilegiat este limitat si monitorizat?
text.en: Is privileged access restricted and monitored?

recommendation.ro: Implementati PAM/PIM si monitorizare pentru toate conturile privilegiate.
recommendation.en: Implement PAM/PIM and monitoring for all privileged accounts.

text.ro: Se face recertificare periodica a drepturilor?
text.en: Is there a periodic access recertification?

recommendation.ro: Introduceti recertificare periodica a accesului pentru utilizatori si terti.
recommendation.en: Introduce periodic access recertification for users and third parties.

text.ro: MFA este activ pentru accesul la sisteme critice?
text.en: Is MFA enabled for access to critical systems?

recommendation.ro: Activati MFA pentru toate sistemele critice, acces remote si conturi privilegiate.
recommendation.en: Enable MFA for all critical systems, remote access and privileged accounts.

text.ro: Exista segregarea rolurilor pentru functiile sensibile?
text.en: Is segregation of duties implemented for sensitive functions?

recommendation.ro: Definiti matrice SoD si controale preventive / detective pentru conflicte de roluri.
recommendation.en: Define an SoD matrix and preventive / detective controls for role conflicts.

text.ro: Conturile inactive sunt dezactivate prompt?
text.en: Are inactive accounts disabled promptly?

recommendation.ro: Automatizati dezactivarea conturilor inactive si a conturilor de fosti angajati.
recommendation.en: Automate the disabling of inactive accounts and former employee accounts.

text.ro: Parolele si autentificarea sunt protejate prin politici adecvate?
text.en: Are passwords and authentication protected by adequate policies?

recommendation.ro: Adoptati passphrases, protectie impotriva password spraying si secret management adecvat.
recommendation.en: Adopt passphrases, password spraying protection and proper secret management.

text.ro: Exista procese formale de patch management?
text.en: Are formal patch management processes in place?

recommendation.ro: Implementati patch management bazat pe risc si SLA-uri de remediere.
recommendation.en: Implement risk-based patch management with remediation SLAs.

text.ro: Log-urile sistemelor critice sunt colectate si protejate?
text.en: Are logs from critical systems collected and protected?

recommendation.ro: Centralizati log-urile critice in SIEM si protejati integritatea acestora.
recommendation.en: Centralize critical logs in a SIEM and protect their integrity.

text.ro: Exista segregare intre mediile de productie, test si dezvoltare?
text.en: Is there segregation between production, test and development environments?

recommendation.ro: Separati mediile si controlati promovarea schimbarilor intre medii.
recommendation.en: Separate environments and control change promotion between them.

text.ro: Backup-urile sunt testate periodic?
text.en: Are backups periodically tested?

recommendation.ro: Testati periodic restaurarea backup-urilor si validati RTO/RPO.
recommendation.en: Periodically test backup restoration and validate RTO/RPO.

text.ro: Exista protectie impotriva malware pe sisteme si endpoint-uri?
text.en: Is malware protection deployed on systems and endpoints?

recommendation.ro: Implementati EDR/AV si proceduri de raspuns la malware.
recommendation.en: Implement EDR/AV and malware response procedures.

text.ro: Exista schimbari aprobate si testate inainte de implementare?
text.en: Are changes approved and tested before implementation?

recommendation.ro: Formalizati change management cu aprobare, testare si rollback.
recommendation.en: Formalize change management with approval, testing and rollback.

text.ro: Exista proceduri de hardening pentru sisteme si aplicatii?
text.en: Are hardening procedures defined for systems and applications?

recommendation.ro: Standardizati baseline-uri de hardening pentru servere, endpoint-uri si servicii.
recommendation.en: Standardize hardening baselines for servers, endpoints and services.

text.ro: Se monitorizeaza capacitatea si disponibilitatea sistemelor critice?
text.en: Are capacity and availability of critical systems monitored?

recommendation.ro: Monitorizati capacitatea si disponibilitatea pentru a preveni degradarea serviciilor.
recommendation.en: Monitor capacity and availability to prevent service degradation.

text.ro: Exista un plan de raspuns la incidente documentat?
text.en: Is there a documented incident response plan?

recommendation.ro: Definiti si testati un plan de raspuns la incidente cu roluri clare.
recommendation.en: Define and test an incident response plan with clear roles.

text.ro: Incidentele sunt clasificate si raportate conform unor criterii?
text.en: Are incidents classified and reported according to criteria?

recommendation.ro: Definiti severitati, criterii de escalare si proceduri de raportare.
recommendation.en: Define severity levels, escalation criteria and reporting procedures.

text.ro: Sunt efectuate exercitii de incident response?
text.en: Are incident response exercises performed?

recommendation.ro: Planificati tabletop-uri si exercitii tehnice pentru incidente majore.
recommendation.en: Plan tabletop and technical exercises for major incidents.

text.ro: Exista analiza post-incident si actiuni corective?
text.en: Is there post-incident analysis and corrective action?

recommendation.ro: Instituiti post-mortem obligatoriu si urmarire a actiunilor corective.
recommendation.en: Establish mandatory post-incident review and corrective action tracking.

text.ro: Exista planuri de continuitate si recuperare pentru procese critice?
text.en: Are continuity and recovery plans in place for critical processes?

recommendation.ro: Definiti si mentineti planuri BCP/DR pentru procesele si sistemele critice.
recommendation.en: Define and maintain BCP/DR plans for critical processes and systems.

text.ro: Planurile de continuitate sunt testate periodic?
text.en: Are continuity plans periodically tested?

recommendation.ro: Testati periodic planurile de continuitate si actualizati lectiile invatate.
recommendation.en: Periodically test continuity plans and update lessons learned.

text.ro: RTO si RPO sunt definite pentru serviciile critice?
text.en: Are RTO and RPO defined for critical services?

recommendation.ro: Definiti RTO/RPO pe baza impactului asupra business-ului si validati-le.
recommendation.en: Define RTO/RPO based on business impact and validate them.

text.ro: Exista comunicare de criza pentru clienti si parti interesate?
text.en: Is there crisis communication for customers and stakeholders?

recommendation.ro: Creati un plan de comunicare de criza pentru clienti, management si autoritati.
recommendation.en: Create a crisis communication plan for customers, management and authorities.
